title: ghillie extension acceptance statement
description: The machine-checkable statement of what an extension's non-visual surface is supposed to do — 'here is what done looks like', re-runnable in the cleanroom. This document describes STRUCTURE only; whether the checks hold is established later by a separate proven acceptance core through a thin exec-shim. Design: project_extension_test_gate_and_catalogue.

id.description: Kebab-case identifier for the extension's purpose.

sentence.description: One human sentence stating what the surface is meant to do.

checks.description: Non-empty list of re-runnable observations of the surface.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier, unique within this document.

given.description: The input this check hands to the surface.

file.description: Bundle-relative input path. No absolute paths, no '..' segments.

args.description: Extra arguments appended after the run argv.

run.description: Argv relative to the bundle root. The token {given} expands to given.file, then given.args are appended. No absolute paths, no '..' segments in any token.

expect.description: What the run should produce. At least one field must be set; exit_code defaults to 0 when unset.

stdout_exact.description: The exact stdout the run should produce; "" means expect empty output.

stdout_matches.description: An RE2 regular expression stdout should match.

exit_code.description: The exit status the run should end with. Defaults to 0.
